Ninguna plataforma de gestión empresaria: No business management platform is written entirely from scratch. Zyntello's rests on free and open source components developed by third parties —the framework the application runs on, the libraries that generate PDFs and Excel files, those that read barcodes, those that draw the charts, and the fonts and icons of the interface—.
Cada uno de esos componentes se distribu: Each of those components is distributed under its own licence, and nearly all of those licences require the same thing: that the author's copyright notice be kept and that whoever receives the software knows where it comes from. This document is how Zyntello meets that obligation, and at the same time the answer to a legitimate question from any subscriber: what is the system I trust my accounts to actually built on?
<b>Lo que este documento no es.</b> Que: What this document is not. The fact that the Platform incorporates open source components does not make it free software nor grant any right over Zyntello's own code. Each component's licence covers that component and nothing else. The regime of the Platform as a whole is that of section 10 of the Terms of Service: a limited licence of use while the subscription is in force.
A la inversa, tampoco los Términos de Zy: Conversely, Zyntello's Terms cannot cut back what a third party's licence grants either. Where the two say different things about a component, the component's licence prevails.

<strong>Permisivas</strong> (MIT, BSD, I: Permissive (MIT, BSD, ISC, Apache 2.0).
